definitions.explanation: A yellowish green, like young leaves and fresh shoots. {黄緑|きみどり} alone means the same color; adding {色|いろ} makes it explicitly "the color."

examples.japanese: {黄緑色|きみどりいろ}の{葉|は}。
{春|はる}の{新芽|しんめ}は{黄緑色|きみどりいろ}をしている。
{木|き}の{芽|め}が{芽吹|めぶ}き、{山|やま}{全体|ぜんたい}が{黄緑色|きみどりいろ}に{染|そ}まった。
examples.english: The buds came out and the whole mountain turned yellow-green.

notes:
A yellowish green, the color of new leaves and fresh shoots. Interchangeable with {黄緑|きみどり}; the {色|いろ} simply makes "color" explicit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黄緑色|きみどりいろ}の{葉|は}: yellow-green leaves
- {黄緑色|きみどりいろ}に{染|そ}まる: to be dyed yellow-green

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {黄緑|きみどり}: yellow-green — the same color, without {色|いろ}
